steps.journalDescription: Weft said that he was being summoned by Chief Tabor. I can find the chief in the center of camp.
Chief Tabor has me working on a construction detail. I'm to meet Tabor in the north west section of the camp, which is just north of the Manse.

Tabor was called away to handle a 'situation', leaving Weft and I to get our midday meals on our own. I should head to the mess hall, which the Chief said was the large building with a wooden roof in the camp's southeast corner.
Enter the unfinished shack in the northwest corner of the camp and kill the bat there.
Return to Chief Tabor for your next assignment.
Use the Crank next to the unfinished shack in the northwest corner of the camp.
Return to Chief Tabor for your next assignment.
Have two Party Members stand on the two buttons inside the shack to clear the rubble.
Return to Chief Tabor for your next assignment.
Remove the wall patch at the back of the unfinished shack in the northwest corner of the camp.
Return to Chief Tabor for your next assignment.

Chief Tabor sent me to get my lunch from the mess hall while he deals with something. I should head to the mess hall in the southeast corner of the camp and speak to the cook there. Once I'm finished with that, I should return to Chief Tabor in the northeast section of the camp.
I should meet with Chief Tabor in the northeast section of the camp.
